name.description:
The test case name is taken from the appended heading texts. If there is no preceding heading, "test" is used.
All names are unique within the test suite so they can be used for result reporting.

lineNumber.description: If loaded from a Markdown file, the line number of the fenced code block.

headings.description:
The text of the headings active at the point of this test code block. The first heading is the outermost one
and the latter ones (if any) are innermost (deeper nesting level) headings.

comment.description:
The text of Markdown (other than headings) associated with this test case. Note that this may contain
multiple lines.

source.description: The original test code from the fenced code block.

actionRequirement.description: The {@link Action.Requirement} this test case applies to.

title:
For a test case in a single language, the type of the code block is an identifier of that language. Note that
the source code then must be legal for that language, and is _not_ parsed as "test script." The source will be
output to the test (only in that language) as-is.

For example, by specifying the "JavaScript" language, this code blocks defines a NativeCase:

    ```js
    let n = 2 + 2;
    expect(n).toBe(4);
    ```

Not only must the test be legal in that language, it must include assertions in the associated test framework to
be useful.
name: TestSuite.NativeCase
